description: Canonical corpus for the schema_version 1 screen-checkpoint contract (scripts/install-checkpoints.py). Run by tests/test_install_checkpoints_corpus.py: each run builds an evidence directory from `frames` (pixels drawn with Pillow, OCR transcript served by a stub tesseract; ocr_exit makes the stub fail the way a timed-out tesseract does) and runs the real script. `expect.checkpoints` is the exact [outcome, reason] of every checkpoint in the run; `expect.exit` the exact exit code; `expect.tap` lines that must appear verbatim. Synthetic data: no transcript here was read off a real frame.
